author: Mr.B
text:
JZ1986 wrote: EURUSD H1 spotted a couple of important FTRs, I hope they're right

J.Z

sorry about the resolution

That fakeout you marked is a beautiful fakeout but why? Think about it from the IT's point of view. We have a defined S/R which is really obvious for everyone. When retail or the herd is short from that SR where would they probably have put their stops? (Think about it) IT's usually have 2 problems. First, they don't want retailers to follow them and second, they have massive amounts of orders to get filled for which they want the best possible price. Now when price shoots up what do you think retail would do? Price reaches your FTR and pins the S/R what orders would have been triggered? Fakeouts are there for a reason and they often spike to S/D or S/R. Just my thoughts.
